title: The Basics
source: Restored from the supplied UI and block controls.

steps.text: Drag a block from the library onto the grid. Select it in the workspace or hierarchy, then change its dimensions and color.
Drag a block to move it. Use one finger on empty space to orbit, two fingers to pan, and pinch to zoom. Save your work before leaving.

title: Dimensions and shapes
source: New restoration guidance: the supplied Lesson 2 had no working content.

steps.text: Create each shape: Cube, Triangular Prism, Cylinder, Trapezoid and Half Cylinder. Compare their width, height and length controls.
Dimensions use the original prefab scale units. Width is the horizontal span, including for cylinders. Place blocks on flat support surfaces, then try undoing a resize.

title: Build a Simple House
source: Restored from the supplied house lesson; reference images supplied.

steps.text: 1. Create a base using a rectangular block.
2. Create a Triangular Prism for the roof. Match its base width and length to the walls below. Place the flat bottom on top of the base. Sloped faces are not support surfaces.

title: Build a Garden Scene
source: New restoration guidance based on supplied Lesson4 reference images; original full text was absent.

steps.text: Create a green ground block. Build a house, chairs and fences using the reference images.
Add a fountain and flower bushes. Compare spacing, height and colors with the target.

title: Build a City Scene
source: New restoration guidance based on supplied lesson5 reference images; original full text was absent.

steps.text: Create the ground and roads, then add buildings using stacked blocks.
Add a park, benches, bus stop and a car. Keep the scale consistent.

title: Build a Playground Scene
source: Restored from supplied lesson6.dart and images.

steps.text: 1. Create the ground using a Cube. Apply green color for grass.
2. Create a swing using Trapezoids, Cylinders, Half-Cylinders, and Cubes.
3. Add a seesaw using a Cube and Trapezoid.
5. Create a plant using a Cylinder and Cubes. Use bright colors, keep spacing even and avoid overcrowding.

title: Build a Coffee Shop
source: Restored from supplied lesson7.dart; roof label aligned with the existing Triangular Prism prefab.

steps.text: 1. Create the ground using a Cube. Use gray and green colors.
3. Add a roof using a Triangular Prism.
4. Create tables and chairs using Cylinders and Cubes. Keep furniture proportional, use warm colors and align neatly.
